status: Command Menu complete at assigned native/Lit boundary; M15 complete
implementation: Composes the public Dialog, Input and Scroll Area without another overlay or text-input engine
Stable identifiers, readable labels and immutable keyword arrays; existing command-score ranking with group boundaries
Manual projection at root and group levels retains author-owned DOM and keyed renderer identity
Single serializable selection/input/open events, cancelable selection and dismissal, application-owned pages
Opt-in document-scoped TanStack hotkeys with disconnect/adoption cleanup
Explicit coalesced load-more requests; application owns network state and stale responses
Active-descendant/autocomplete forwarding through the existing semantic bridge, live result status and supporting descriptions
Command Separator replaces Command Divider; old page/timer/callback/overlay interfaces and style producers are removed

A short navigation timeout occurred during parallel test load; the healthy server returned HTTP 200, and the final documentation run passed with a bounded navigation timeout.
